alpha_factor_descriptions: Momentum factors are based on the idea that stocks that have performed well in the past will continue to perform well in the future.
Mean reversion factors are based on the idea that stock prices will revert to their historical means over time.
Statistical arbitrage factors are based on the idea that mispricings in the market can be exploited by taking long and short positions in related securities.
